answer: Rewards vest on a ramp tied to identity age: an agent's first epoch pays 10% of its earned share, rising 10 points per epoch of continuous honest work, and the unpaid remainder stays locked as an anchor that is burned if that identity is caught submitting duplicated answers. Age comes from the ledger's own signed history, so any peer can recompute it. A farm that spins up fifty fresh clones gets fifty identities stuck at 10%, each needing ten epochs of real work; splitting a veteran cannot copy its age. It is no fable that this also slows an honest newcomer's first voyage.
